{"source":"import Base

# Each field is a bit-plane: thirty-two cells count without carrying between them.
type Counts is Data:
  Counts{one: U32, two: U32, four: U32, eight: U32}

# One vote ripples through every selected bit-sliced counter at once.
def Counts.vote(counts: Counts, +votes: U32) -> Counts:
  match counts:
    case Counts{+one, +two, +four, eight}:
      +into_two = U32.and(one, votes)
      +into_four = U32.and(two, into_two)
      into_eight = U32.and(four, into_four)
      Counts{
        U32.xor(one, votes),
        U32.xor(two, into_two),
        U32.xor(four, into_four),
        U32.xor(eight, into_eight)
      }

# A row casts left, center and right; a zero center excludes the focal row.
def Counts.cast(counts: Counts, +row: U32, center: U32) -> Counts:
  Counts.vote(
    Counts.vote(
      Counts.vote(counts, U32.shl(row)),
      center),
    U32.shr(row))

# B3/S23: has two, lacks four-or-eight, and is odd-or-alive.
def Life.rule(counts: Counts, alive: U32) -> U32:
  match counts:
    case Counts{one, two, four, eight}:
      U32.and(
        two,
        U32.and(
          U32.not(U32.or(four, eight)),
          U32.or(one, alive)))

# Three casts form the Moore stencil: 3 above, 2 here, 3 below.
def Life.row(+above: U32, +here: U32, +below: U32) -> U32:
  Life.rule(
    Counts.cast(
      Counts.cast(
        Counts.cast(Counts{0, 0, 0, 0}, above, above),
        here,
        0),
      below,
      below),
    here)

# Fold one row-major slice into a word, least-significant cell first.
def Rows.pack.one(
  cells: List<&2, U32>, +shift: Nat, row: U32
) -> U32:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      row
    case cell <> rest:
      Rows.pack.one(
        rest,
        1n+shift,
        U32.or(row, U32.shln(cell, shift)))

# Repeat that fold without changing the board's row order.
def Rows.pack(
  height: Nat, +width: Nat, +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      Rows.pack.one(List.take(&2, U32, cells, width), 0n, 0)
        <> Rows.pack(rest, width, List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width))

# Unroll one cell per fuel: shift the born row, then roll the vertical halo.
def Life.unroll(
  fuel: Nat,
  columns: Nat,
  rows: List<&2, U32>,
  +above: U32,
  +width: Nat,
  +born: U32
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match fuel columns:
    case 0n _:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest 1n+more:
      match more:
        case 0n:
          match rows:
            case Nil{}:
              U32.and(born, 1) <> Nil{}
            case +here <> +below:
              match below:
                case Nil{}:
                  U32.and(born, 1)
                    <> Life.unroll(
                      rest,
                      width,
                      Nil{},
                      here,
                      width,
                      Life.row(above, here, 0))
                case next <> _:
                  U32.and(born, 1)
                    <> Life.unroll(
                      rest,
                      width,
                      below,
                      here,
                      width,
                      Life.row(above, here, next))
        case 1n+left:
          U32.and(born, 1)
            <> Life.unroll(
              rest,
              1n+left,
              rows,
              above,
              width,
              U32.shr(born))

# The absent row above the first packed row is the initial dead boundary.
def Life.unroll.start(
  fuel: Nat, +width: Nat, rows: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match rows:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case +here <> +below:
      match below:
        case Nil{}:
          Life.unroll(
            fuel,
            width,
            Nil{},
            here,
            width,
            Life.row(0, here, 0))
        case next <> _:
          Life.unroll(
            fuel,
            width,
            below,
            here,
            width,
            Life.row(0, here, next))

def step(
  width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +columns = U32.to_nat(width)
  +rows = U32.to_nat(height)
  Life.unroll.start(
    Nat.mul(columns, rows),
    columns,
    Rows.pack(rows, columns, cells))

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+rest:
      evolve(rest, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
","hypothesis":"Concrete improvement hypothesis: the weak part of the prior presentation was treating the return conversion as a separate unpacking pass. `Life.unroll` instead uses total cell count as structural fuel, emits one low bit at a time, and rolls the original-row halo exactly when the column counter reaches the edge. Thus horizontal unpacking and vertical sweeping become one terminating stream transducer. The Life predicate is also compressed to the direct mask `two & ~(four | eight) & (one | alive)`.","findings":"The runtime and semantic feedback remain confirmed: all observed Node, Bun, native and composition cases passed, with no semantic findings. The style finding is confirmed. This revision concretely removes `Rows.unpack.one`, `Rows.unpack`, and the separate `Life.sweep`; their work is integrated into `Life.unroll`, while the B3/S23 mask is simplified. The previously repaired parameter-only match discipline is preserved."}
